payload.text: For hv: Intent's pre-commit hook template word-splits staged Markdown paths (for f in $MD_FILES; prettier --list-different $MD_WHOLE), so it breaks on any .md with a space in its name. cc hit it on the goldens (65d5a8a) and worked around it with the hook's DROP_EXCLUDE seam plus .prettierignore. The fix is Intent's, out of pplr's scope (hv: just Pplr for now).
